_about: Public-domain Richard Hurrell Froude (1803-1836, Fellow of Oriel and an originator of the Oxford Movement) for the Word Hoard: the Remains of the late Reverend Richard Hurrell Froude (4 vols, London and Derby, 1838-1839), his journals, letters, sermons and essays, edited anonymously by Newman and Keble, from Internet Archive scans. Written in English. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 27 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
